name: Wehrmacht (Ostheer)
blurb: Flexible mid-game tech. Strong MG suppression, mortars, and StuG/Panzer IV mid. Weak early light vehicle answer until Pak or flamer.

name: Soviets
blurb: Cheap bodies and strong mid armor (T-70/T-34). Conscripts + Penals set early pace. Needs AT answer before enemy mediums stabilize.

name: Oberkommando West
blurb: Battlegroup HQs instead of a classic base. Strong late vehicles (Panther/JT) and infra. Vulnerable if early fuel/munitions denial sticks.

name: US Forces
blurb: Riflemen core, captains/lieutenants for leadership, and strong combined arms. Pathfinders and major unlocks define mid timing.

name: British Forces
blurb: Section infantry with emplacements and a tech-heavy mid. Vickers/6-pdr hold ground; Churchills and Comets close games.
